Green Lantern Corps

Voz

A Lantern guarding Oa’s Sciencells.

Voz is a Green Lantern associated with Oa’s Sciencells. His stories show the Corps’ responsibilities as jailers as well as patrol officers.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Green Lantern Corps
First appearance
Guy Gardner #11 (1993)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Green Lantern Corps #35 places Voz alongside Guy Gardner, Kyle Rayner and Kilowog when a Red Lantern escape becomes a prison riot. His position does not make the Sciencells infallible. The crisis is a useful entry into Emerald Eclipse because it reveals institutional vulnerability without relying on unsupported claims that no prisoner had ever escaped or been rehabilitated.

Key Stories

  • Emerald Eclipse
    Green Lantern Corps #35 (2009), the prison crisis
